races.name: Book The Bistro At Southwell Racecourse Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Fern Hill
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner whose hold-up style is perfectly suited to this staying trip on good ground

runners_data.name: Hell Hound
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with excellent recent going form including a win on good ground

runners_data.name: Queens Wish
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent performer but lacks a recent win despite multiple placed efforts

runners_data.name: Always Busy
runners_data.note: Solid each-way claims from prominent position but question marks over recent completion rate

runners_data.name: Le Beau Gosse
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated with poor similar going record, needs everything to fall right from rear

runners_data.name: Noche Negra
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter but concerning lack of recent wins despite getting lead opportunities

races.paceDynamic: Noche Negra will likely set the early fractions with Hell Hound, Queens Wish, and Always Busy tracking closely behind in the prominent positions, creating a solid tempo without being overly aggressive. The two hold-up horses Fern Hill and Le Beau Gosse will settle at the rear, relying on the sustained pace over this staying trip to set up their late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio of Hell Hound, Queens Wish and Always Busy maintain steady pressure on Noche Negra throughout
scenarios.body: The relentless tempo will suit the proven stayers and expose any stamina limitations. Hell Hound's solid going form and Queens Wish's consistency at this level come to the fore.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Wins Out
scenarios.trigger: If Noche Negra and the prominent group go steady early, allowing the hold-up pair to get into contention
scenarios.body: Fern Hill's superior rating and proven ability on similar going conditions become decisive factors in a late surge. The class differential shows when the pace lifts approaching the final fences.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Running Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Noche Negra gets an uncontested lead with the prominent horses failing to apply sufficient pressure
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage and stays on strongly to the line despite modest recent form. Always Busy emerges best of the chasers having tracked the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or mistakes disrupt the early running and create a stop-start gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Le Beau Gosse's hold-up style proves unexpectedly effective despite his lower rating. Queens Wish's tactical speed gives her an edge in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: If Always Busy shows early reluctance or jumping errors given the recent question marks over completion
Watch Hell Hound's jumping rhythm early as any mistakes could compromise his prominent racing style
Monitor how aggressively Queens Wish tracks the early pace as she needs to be handy to use her consistency
Check if Fern Hill gets too far back early as he'll need to be within striking distance turning for home
Observe whether Noche Negra gets the uncontested lead that his recent form suggests he requires

races.name: Easter Family Fun Day 5th April Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Ukantango
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs the race to develop into a sprint finish to showcase his OR 109 rating

runners_data.name: Big Boy Barney
runners_data.note: Recent course winner whose tactical speed and jumping ability make him dangerous from any position

runners_data.name: Kayce Dutton
runners_data.note: Stays well at longer trips but has been inconsistent, needs everything to fall right

runners_data.name: Gilbertina
runners_data.note: Natural prominently-raced horse who could kick clear if allowed to dictate from the front

runners_data.name: Intenzo
runners_data.note: Most likely leader whose recent good form on similar ground makes him hard to dismiss

runners_data.name: Boston Boy
runners_data.note: Capable on his day but recent poor jumping suggests confidence issues that may persist

races.paceDynamic: Intenzo will likely take the lead with Gilbertina tracking prominently, setting a manageable gallop that won't stretch the field early. The four hold-up horses (Ukantango, Big Boy Barney, Kayce Dutton, Boston Boy) will settle behind, creating a compressed field that should produce a tactical finish where jumping and positioning at the business end becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Intenzo and Gilbertina maintain control without being pressured early.
scenarios.body: The front two get first run turning for home with the hold-up horses struggling to make up ground on the testing climb to the line. Intenzo's recent good form on similar ground gives him the edge over Gilbertina in a prolonged battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Gilbertina pushes the pace from the back straight onward.
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and finds out the stamina reserves, with Big Boy Barney's recent win showing he can handle a stronger pace better than the others. Kayce Dutton's staying power also comes into play at this longer trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady and the race sets up for closers.
scenarios.body: Ukantango and Big Boy Barney get perfect runs from the back to challenge late, with their higher ratings telling when the race becomes a sprint finish. The front runners pay for their early efforts on ground that may be testing their stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Boston Boy Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Boston Boy jumps with renewed confidence and gets a clear run.
scenarios.body: His previous course win suggests he can handle this track when right, and if his recent poor jumping was just a blip he could surprise at a price. The steady pace would suit his come-from-behind style perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Boston Boy's jumping technique early - if he makes mistakes at the first few fences his chance is gone
Intenzo's jumping under pressure - he needs to maintain fluency when challenged to hold his advantage
Gilbertina's position turning in - if she's still in touch she could outstay the others up the hill
Big Boy Barney's position at the third last - he needs to be within striking distance to use his finishing kick
Kayce Dutton's jumping rhythm - when confident over his fences he's a completely different horse

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Mares' Standard NH Flat Race (Cond'/Am') (Cat 1) (GBB)
Country And Western Night 25th April Maiden Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Papillondelumiere
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity with highest official rating but very limited exposure over hurdles

runners_data.name: Novelista
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who needs strong pace to be effective but struggles on similar going historically

runners_data.name: Road To Wembley
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with excellent record on good ground and strong recent form

runners_data.name: Top Coeur
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up horse with solid record on good going despite limited sample size

runners_data.name: Lou Des Bordes
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with tendency to fade late, making distance stamina a key question mark

runners_data.name: Paragon
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who could provide pace pressure but lacks a win on similar going conditions

runners_data.name: Promethean
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner who holds up but has poor record on good ground with no wins

runners_data.name: Corsican Caper
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent recent third but poor overall strike rate on good going

races.paceDynamic: Road To Wembley will dictate from the front with minimal pressure, as the field lacks other committed pace-setters. This sustainable tempo suits hold-up horses like Novelista, Top Coeur, and Corsican Caper who can stalk and pounce late. The lack of pace pressure means the finish will likely be decided by who has the most left in reserve over the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Road To Wembley gets an easy lead without harassment from Paragon
scenarios.body: Road To Wembley sets his own fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges. The hold-up horses find the pace too slow to mount effective finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate but honest enough for closers to work with
scenarios.body: Novelista and Top Coeur get ideal setups tracking the leaders before unleashing strong finishes. Road To Wembley begins to tire in the final furlong as the closers sweep past.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Paragon travels well and pressures Road To Wembley throughout the middle stages
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches Road To Wembley while Paragon maintains his position to strike in the straight. Hold-up horses find themselves too far back as the tempo quickens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Papillondelumiere or Lou Des Bordes show significant improvement from limited previous form
scenarios.body: One of the unknowns capitalizes on fitness or natural ability that hasn't been fully exposed yet. The established form horses find themselves unable to match the progression shown.

watchPoints.text: Road To Wembley could get too easy a lead if Paragon doesn't take him on early
Lou Des Bordes has shown late-race fading tendencies that could be exposed again over this trip
Novelista needs the pace to be strong enough to set up his finishing kick effectively
Papillondelumiere's market moves will reveal connections' confidence given his limited hurdling experience
Top Coeur's jumping fluency will be crucial given his hold-up style requires clean passage through the field

races.name: Southwell Racecourse Conference And Events Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Immortal Fame
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who will look to dictate terms but needs to prove stamina at this extended trip

runners_data.name: El Galactico
runners_data.note: Class act with strong recent form who relies entirely on the pace collapsing for his trademark finishing kick

runners_data.name: Jubilant
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer whose two wins from fifteen on good ground highlight he needs everything to fall right

runners_data.name: Moon Hunter
runners_data.note: Course and distance third last time out gives him a fitness edge over several rivals here

runners_data.name: Passing Pleasure
runners_data.note: Versatile performer equally effective prominent or tracking who handles the going conditions well

runners_data.name: Ocean Conquest
runners_data.note: Forward-going type whose three wins on good ground make him dangerous if getting an uncontested lead

runners_data.name: Campaign Trail
runners_data.note: Solid recent efforts at this trip suggest he's found his niche over staying distances

runners_data.name: Diamond Geezer
runners_data.note: Rare runner on good ground with only one previous experience making him hard to assess

races.paceDynamic: Immortal Fame and Passing Pleasure will likely set a measured gallop early with Ocean Conquest and Campaign Trail close up, creating a sustainable pace over this stamina test. The cluster of hold-up horses (El Galactico, Jubilant, Moon Hunter, Diamond Geezer) means the real race begins from the second-last hurdle as they all need the pace to collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain a solid gallop throughout without significant slowing
scenarios.body: Immortal Fame and Passing Pleasure get first run on the field while the hold-up brigade struggle to close from too far back. Ocean Conquest benefits from his forward position to capitalize late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses for Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders weaken significantly from the second-last hurdle creating a slow finish
scenarios.body: El Galactico and Jubilant get the perfect setup as the race becomes a sprint finish over the final furlong. Diamond Geezer also benefits from his proven closing kick in these conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If Ocean Conquest or Campaign Trail make a bold mid-race move to steal a march
scenarios.body: The early injection of pace catches both the leaders and hold-up horses off guard, creating tactical confusion. Campaign Trail's solid recent form at this trip makes him dangerous if getting first run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Adaptable Types
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with multiple horses vying for position throughout
scenarios.body: The race develops into a tactical affair where horses comfortable in any position hold the advantage. Passing Pleasure's versatility and Moon Hunter's recent third over course and distance become key factors.

watchPoints.text: Diamond Geezer has never placed in eleven runs on good ground making him a complete unknown quantity
Moon Hunter's recent course and distance experience could prove decisive if the pace sets up right
Immortal Fame needs to prove his stamina holds at this trip having never won beyond two and a half miles
El Galactico requires a strong pace to set up his finishing kick but most dangers also come from behind
Campaign Trail's recent consistency at staying trips suggests he's found his optimal distance range

runners_data.name: Briery Butterfly
runners_data.note: Likely pacesetter with sustainable style but needs to find improvement on recent efforts

runners_data.name: Rosa Diaz
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer who should get ideal conditions from this pace setup

runners_data.name: Princesse Milania
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up mare whose recent form suggests she's in good heart

runners_data.name: Belladinotte
runners_data.note: Proven course winner whose style perfectly suits the likely race shape

runners_data.name: Shorten Sassy
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner to track the leader and recent form gives her claims

runners_data.name: Mya Du Clos
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from heavy ground where she struggled last time

runners_data.name: Venturevango
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with tendency to fade when it matters most

races.paceDynamic: Briery Butterfly will likely set a measured gallop with Shorten Sassy tracking prominently, creating a sustainable pace that should suit the strong hold-up contingent. The lack of genuine pace pressure early means Rosa Diaz, Princesse Milania, Belladinotte, Mya Du Clos and Venturevango can all settle and deliver late kicks. This sets up a classic stamina test where the strongest finisher should prevail.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Favors Class
scenarios.trigger: If Briery Butterfly sets an even gallop without early pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test where superior class tells in the final furlong. Rosa Diaz and Princesse Milania can unleash their strongest finishes from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Control Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Briery Butterfly and Shorten Sassy work together and keep it steady
scenarios.body: The prominent pair get first run on the field and maintain their advantage to the line. Shorten Sassy's better recent form gives her the edge over the pacesetter.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge from Deep
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and hold-up horses get ideal splits
scenarios.body: Belladinotte and Mya Du Clos benefit most from a sprint finish, with Belladinotte's proven course form decisive. The stronger finishers catch the early leaders in the final 100 yards.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finale
scenarios.trigger: If Briery Butterfly goes too slow and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: All the hold-up horses converge simultaneously in a blanket finish. Princesse Milania's recent consistency edges a tight photo from the improving Belladinotte.

watchPoints.text: Venturevango has faded badly in recent finishes and may struggle to sustain any effort
Briery Butterfly must judge the pace correctly as she faces stronger hold-up opposition than usual
Rosa Diaz will need clear room to unleash her finish given the number of hold-up horses behind her
Mya Du Clos drops significantly in trip from recent 16f efforts which may not suit her rhythm
Shorten Sassy represents the main danger to a hold-up horse victory if she can track the pace
